map.输入中心频率 f0 与 -3dB 带宽 Δf，求品质因数 Q。: Enter center frequency f0 and -3dB bandwidth Delta f to find the quality factor Q.
map.Q = f₀/Δf，越大选择性越好。: Q = f0/Delta f, the larger the better the selectivity.
map.谐振器 Q = f0 / 带宽，衡量储能与损耗比。: Resonator Q = f0 / bandwidth, measuring the ratio of stored energy to loss.

map.Q = 1000 / 100 = 10；若 BW 收窄到 10Hz，则 Q=10: Q = 1000 / 100 = 10; if BW narrows to 10Hz, then Q=100 (better selectivity).
map.若 BW=500Hz，则 Q=2，宽带低选择性、损耗相对大。: If BW=500Hz, then Q=2, wideband with low selectivity and relatively large loss.
map.Q 越高代表什么？: What does a higher Q mean?
map.Q 高表示损耗小、谐振尖锐、选频能力强，但带宽窄。: A high Q means low loss, sharp resonance and strong frequency selectivity, but a narrow bandwidth.
map.Q 与带宽关系？: What is the relation between Q and bandwidth?
map.Q = f0/BW，二者成反比，高 Q 必窄带。: Q = f0/BW, inversely proportional; a high Q necessarily means a narrow band.
